what: Thumbnails lined up in a row: once the top edge of the row reaches 80% of the screen, each one grows with clip-path from a single point at its top-left corner to its full size — one by one starting .15s later at .08s intervals, 1.05s power3.inOut. The accompanying rule is drawn from the left at 0s over .85s. Plays once

options.dur: Time for one thumbnail to grow (sec), default 1.05
options.delay: Seconds from underline start to thumbnail start, default .15
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.77,0,0.175,1”, default power3.inOut
options.corner: Corner where growth starts 「top left」 (default)·「top right」·「bottom left」·「bottom right」
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Thumbnails to grow (children). If none, all children that are not rule — those with display:none are skipped
options.[data-fx-part=rule]: (if any) underline on the line — drawn from the left

note: Hidden thumbnails (display:none so only two show on phones) are skipped so the visible ones are spaced evenly

from.where: index.html .cat (category row) — original home category row: rule scaleX .85 power3.inOut @0, visible thumbnails clip inset(0 100% 100% 0)→0 1.05 power3.inOut stagger .08 @.15, start top 80% once
